'''Warehouse Aurek''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] market owned by the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Hotho Allaran]] located in [[Mos Shuuta/Legends|Mos Shuuta]], a city on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
